subject: Discrepancies in draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference, and found a few discrepancies that require your attention.
Specifically, the Consignee is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA on the draft Bill of Lading, whereas the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.
Additionally, the Notify Party is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA on the draft, but the Shipping Instruction specifies EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.
Please amend the draft Bill of Lading so that it matches the Shipping Instruction exactly in both instances.

Best regards,
Shipping Operations
